- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The mode check reads Path.stat().st_mode against working-tree files rather than the git index mode, so it can report drift that does not exist in Git's view.
  WHY: When core.fileMode = false, a developer's local chmod can cause the check to report drift and the sync to attempt a no-op content change or fail when commit finds nothing to commit.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The live `pr_merge_status_guard.py`, `audit-plans.md`, `apply-url.md` and `implement-plan-ai.md` are copied from their templates. The live `implement-issue-claude.md` keeps its own text and takes only Phase 2's step 4/5 label-confirmation wording, because the copies differ on purpose." (PR description, "What changes" section.) Reinforced by the changelog table row "Live copies synced in this change | 5 (1 hook, 4 commands)" and by the "Root cause" table that names `commands/audit-plans.md` as one of the four #6176 templates whose live copy must be synced.
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md`
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff modifies `.claude/commands/apply-url.md`, `.claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md`, `.claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md`, and `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`. No `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` hunk appears anywhere in the diff, and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` is also untouched here (so the template and live copy are either already in sync, or the live copy is still drifted). The PR description and the changelog both count 4 commands synced (audit-plans, apply-url, implement-plan-ai, implement-issue-claude), but only 3 commands are modified in the diff. The PR's own test report claims `tests/test_audit_plans_command.py::test_template_parity` now passes alongside 5,005 other tests, so the live copy must already match the template; in that case the count and the "What changes" prose should read 3 commands (and list only apply-url, implement-plan-ai, implement-issue-claude), not 4. As written the PR advertises work that the diff does not contain, so a reviewer cannot tell from the diff whether audit-plans.md is intentionally already in sync or whether a sync step was silently dropped.

  confidence=3
